guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Cadia 地下金銅礦
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Cadia underground gold/copper mine
guides.concept: 以panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水解析Cadia 地下金銅礦：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Cadia underground gold/copper mine through panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識地下grade與取樣。品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。 建立資源品位與代表採樣的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識panel caving物料路徑。露天、地下與重力砂金路徑的邊界不同；搬運與支撐影響能量和風險。 建立開坑地下與搬運的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫礦石、廢石與人員／設備分開的概念路徑。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識碎礦與磨礦能量。粒徑減小可能提高解離但增加能耗與細泥；粒度不是金屬回收率。 建立粒徑解離與破碎的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想粒度分佈、解離率與單位能耗。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識銅金回收balance。密度、粒徑及形狀共同影響重力分離；精礦品位、產率與回收率不同。 建立重力選別與質量收支的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用給定假想給料與精礦計算金屬守恆。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識地下ventilation供電。地下通風與電力是支援系統；自動搬運需感測、通信與人員隔離。 建立通風電力與自動化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較失去一項支援時的概念依賴，不操作真實礦井。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識尾礦與長期水管理。尾礦與礦水需質量平衡、監測與長期管理；回收目標不替代環境約束。 建立尾礦水與復育的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify underground grades/sampling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of resources, grade and representative sampling, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify panel-caving material paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Surface, underground and placer routes differ; haulage/support affect energy and risks. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of open-pit, underground and haulage, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw separate conceptual ore, waste and people/equipment paths. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify comminution energy in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Size reduction can improve liberation while increasing energy/slimes; size is not recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of particle size, liberation and comminution, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed size distributions, liberation and specific energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify copper/gold recovery balance in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Density, size and shape affect gravity separation; concentrate grade, yield and recovery differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of gravity separation and mass balance, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check metal balance from assumed feed/concentrate data. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify underground ventilation/power in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Ventilation/power support underground work; automated haulage needs sensing, communications and separation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ventilation, power and automation, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare conceptual lost-support dependencies without operating a mine. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify tailings/long-term water in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Tailings/water need balance, monitoring and long-term management; recovery targets do not replace environmental constraints. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of tailings, water and rehabilitation, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed water/solids balance and rehabilitation evidence. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交地下ventilation供電的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交尾礦與長期水管理的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交尾礦與長期水管理的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for underground ventilation/power.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for tailings/long-term water.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for tailings/long-term water.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：回收率高表示尾礦與礦水沒有影響。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: High recovery means tailings/water have no impact.
